facts.text: The store is open from 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday through Saturday.
Refunds are accepted within 30 days of purchase as long as the item is unused.
All employees receive a 15% discount on regular-priced merchandise.
To file a warranty claim, an employee must first collect the original receipt and then submit form WC-2 to the Customer Service Desk within 14 days of the fault being reported.

Shift allowance table: Early morning | 5 AM - 9 AM | $2.50 per hour; Evening | 6 PM - 10 PM | $1.75 per hour; Overnight | 10 PM - 5 AM | $4.00 per hour; Sunday | All day | $3.00 per hour; Public holiday | All day | 1.5x base pay
Employee records are retained for 7 years after the end of employment.
New employees complete a probation period of 90 days.
Staff must wear the navy Acme polo shirt and closed-toe shoes on the sales floor.
Employees who work more than six hours receive an unpaid 30-minute meal break.
Vacation requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance.
Overtime is paid at 1.5 times the base rate for hours worked beyond 40 hours in a week.
Full-time employees receive eight paid sick days per calendar year.
Any workplace injury must be reported to a manager within 24 hours.
Items left in the lost and found are held for 60 days before being donated.
A cash drawer discrepancy of more than $5 must be reported to the shift lead.
Every new hire completes 12 hours of paid training before working alone.
Employees must park in Lot C behind the loading dock.
